title: Validity conditions for tableau sources
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb N$, let $\rho$ assign a natural number to each of the eleven registers, and let $s$ be a tableau-bit source. The source is valid if it is $z$ and $\rho(8)<\rho(1)$, or if it is a previous-configuration source indexed by $d$ and $j$ and $1\leq\rho(4)+d$. It is also valid if it is a current-configuration source and $1\leq\rho(3)$, or a position source and $1\leq\rho(5)$; constants, $u$, and end-of-tape sources are always valid.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho$ assigns natural numbers to the eleven registers
